obligations.name: onboard_scope_memberships
obligations.description: The conversation memberships (member roster) belonging to the non-archived, non-DM channels of workspace T01WORKSPACE whose topic text covers infrastructure operations or model-training work — i.e. the membership rows on core-infra and model-research.
obligations.scope: conversation memberships on qualifying channels within one visible workspace

task_spec.text: Within workspace T01WORKSPACE, find the non-archived, non-DM channels whose topic describes infrastructure operations or model-training work.
For those channels, list each member so the on-call rotation announcement can be drafted.

access_plan: Actor already knows the workspace ID T01WORKSPACE (no stored workspace-name lookup needed). Call conversations.list with team_id=T01WORKSPACE and types=public_channel,private_channel to enumerate the bounded channel corpus, then read each channel's topic_text and is_archived/is_dm flags via conversations.info to find the qualifying infra/model-training channels (excluding archived, DM, and off-topic channels like growth/frontend/generic-engineering/alpha-dev). For each qualifying channel, call conversations.members to retrieve the member-ID roster; this documented operation returns only member identities, so no join-time attribute is requested or reported.
